description: Use the selected LARK M2 transmitter button to start and stop the existing Domios voice recorder.
configHelp: Before giving setup instructions, run codeterm plugin get lark, then codeterm plugin lark status and codeterm plugin lark diagnostics on the machine with the receiver. Diagnostic verbs are read-only and require the agent_commands grant. The LARK settings show recording status, then Refresh status, Enable LARK, Disable LARK, Show diagnostics in that order. Grant local_recording in Domios plugin permissions before Enable LARK. Show diagnostics exposes the host status and receiver battery report. There is no receiver/microphone picker in LARK settings: the current host owns device selection and may show no picker when no receiver is offered. LARK cannot list devices, remember a selection or reconnect automatically with this host API; a generic host capability is pending. Do not tell the user to pick a device in this settings page. Use the recipient tab menu: Use LARK recording here. Double-press starts the existing recorder; double-press again stops and sends through Transcriber. Connected status proves host attachment, not a working physical button; verify button and battery on the target machine.
